channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jim O'Brien | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jim O'Brien from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Jim O'Brien
item.description:
When team president Larry Bird was ready to make a change, Vogel wanted the job, but he felt for his mentor.

“Obviously my first reaction was disappointment that they're letting go of coach O'Brien,”

Frank Vogel on Jim O'Brien, Feb 14, 2011. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Jim O'Brien
item.description:
“The ironic thing is they called me together, coach and Larry. Larry called me and let me know they were going to make a change, and was I interested? And before I could answer, coach O'Brien interceded and said, 'I'm behind this all the way if you want to do this.'”

Frank Vogel on Jim O'Brien, Feb 14, 2011. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Jim O'Brien
item.description:
“I've been blessed with an incredible relationship with coach O'Brien, who has shown such belief and confidence in me for this day to happen.”

Frank Vogel on Jim O'Brien, Jan 31, 2011. Source: Indianapolis Star.
